title: Discrepancy and Fisher information
summary: We give an online algorithm that keeps a symmetric random walk inside a convex body by discarding some of its steps. The expected number of discarded steps is controlled by a Fisher-information-type quantity associated with the body. For the cube, this gives a dimension-free bound: a walk with unit Euclidean steps can be kept bounded in all coordinates while discarding only a small constant fraction of the steps on average.
